purpose: Prospective supervised comparison on independent hot-rolled steel. All numerical acceptance limits are proposed homework assumptions. No plant requirements or independent outcomes were supplied.
seed_rule: Use the original deployment seed 0. The other paired seeds characterize robustness.
runtime: OpenVINO CPU FP32, batch one, four performance cores, four threads, one stream
head: dense
preprocessing: Decode grayscale, aspect-preserving letterbox to 480, repeat to three channels, divide by 255.
postprocessing: Keep the top-scoring class per anchor at score >= cutoff. Class-wise NMS, IoU 0.70, at most 30000 candidates before NMS and 300 final boxes. A frame alarms on any final box.
object_endpoint: Greedy same-class match at IoU >= 0.50. Each critical class must recover at least nine in ten annotated objects.
clean_strip_endpoint: One predetermined window per independently adjudicated clean strip. Reject the strip if any of its first 100 consecutive, nonoverlapping frame exposures alarms. Count strips equally.
line_endpoint: Elapsed time from camera capture trigger to acknowledged controller decision on a common clock, including capture, queue, transfer and inference. A 20 ms period is an illustrative 50-frame/s deadline.
analysis: Keep the checkpoint, score cutoff and all three acceptance criteria fixed before acquisition. Retain the true coil or acquisition group, strip identity, frame order and inspector annotations. Report numerators and denominators; compare each point estimate with its stated limit. The laptop timer covers only decoded image to final boxes. Keep all decisions under human supervision.
